change_summary: Evaluate exact-original conditional player forecasts against later source-bound final player appearances. Bind original serialized conditional-player report to training receipt; add separate retrospective public player comparison on 2023–25, without changing live means or prices. Add eleven counting-stat retrospective distribution comparisons on identical prior-only player rows, fixed diagnostic half-lines, explicit NB Poisson limit, common smoothing and paired week-block diagnostics.
assumptions: Missing participation remains withheld, never zero-filled or treated as DNP.
Original training bytes and report must replay exactly; final identity and clock must match.
No calibrated probabilities, scheduled grading integration, prop settlement or market release.

Historical player box data are appearance-conditional retrospective data, not pregame active rosters. Common sample requires >=5 same-team prior appearances with >=2 calendar-day lag; no season-specific Division I filter.

Illustrative half-lines are not posted prop contracts. Probability models are participation-conditional only. Fixed per-player 5–8 prior appearances; common smoothing, no selected winning family, no pricing or promotion. Week-block confidence intervals are descriptive and do not account for all cross-week player dependence.

evaluation.test_command: python -m unittest discover -s models/cbb -p test_cbb_run_it.py -v && PYTHONPATH=.:models/cbb python research/cbb_public_player_backtest.py --self-test && PYTHONPATH=.:models/cbb python -m unittest -v research.cbb_player_distribution
